Name: Elle's Kitchen Replacement
Author: junimods
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/n4XdwZb.png[/img]
- 10 colors for cabinets and wood countertops
- 20 colors for tile countertops
- 4 colors for appliances like the fridge and stove
- 4 colors for hardware/handles
- Separate configs for farmhouse, cabin, and island kitchens
- Optional retextures for the Mini-Fridge item

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ad9prRZ.png[/img]

[b][color=#e69138]1[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]2[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]3[/color][/b]. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
[b][color=#e69138]4[/color][/b]. Run the game through SMAPI to generate a config.json, then close.
[color=#e69138][b]5[/b][/color]. Open the config.json with a text program like Notepad and use the images in the References folder to choose colors for counters, wood, appliances, and handles.[b] [/b]For each [font=Courier New]"Counter"[/font] option you may choose between [font=Courier New]"Tile"[/font] and [font=Courier New]"Wood". "Mini Fridge"[/font] and [font=Courier New]"Island Stove"[/font] options are true/false. If you can't get a config.json to generate (for example due to using a mod manager) rename the example_config.json to config.json and use it instead.
[color=#e69138][b]6[/b][/color]. Run the game using SMAPI to play with your new retexture!

There are 3 sets of config options as of 1.1.3: 
1) Farmhouse: These change the kitchen in the main farmhouse (in multiplayer, this is the host's house)
2) Cabin: These change the kitchen in all cabins 
3) Island: To be a bit vague in case you aren't spoiled, these change the new kitchen area added in 1.5

There is also the "Mini Fridge" config to enable/disable retexture of that item, and an "Island Stove" config to enable/disable a recolor of it (matches your "Island Appliances")

To uninstall, just delete the folder you put in your Mods directory.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hxvaHeU.png[/img]﻿

1.1.6 - Made patches update on location change to fix kitchens not appearing in cabins/island farmhouses sometimes
          - Updated format version
1.1.5 - New textures! Updated everything a bit (namely wood/cabinets and range/oven)
          - Changed the "Modern" colors to better match vanilla furniture
          - Updated format version
          - Added another dependency for compatibility
1.1.4 - Added dependencies for interior recolors
1.1.3 - You can now have different looking kitchens in different buildings; there are new configs for the main farmhouse, cabin kitchens, and the new area added in 1.5
          - Thank you to YumeMiru for sending me a save to test the new kitchen! <3
1.1.2 - Added Mini-Fridge retexture (optional, enabled by default)
          - Updated main fridge textures, including the new open animation
          - 4 new tile counter colors: Yellow, Orange, Navy, and Turquoise
1.1.1 - Fixed kitchens no longer appearing due to an update
1.1.0 - These now have a config.json allowing you to pick any combination of tile, wood, appliance, and hardware!
          - You can also choose between wood and tile countertops
          - New tile colors as well as woods to match vanilla furniture
